subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR's guided preview and first-run onboarding experience on top of current main, or close/narrow it in favor of the already-merged onboarding refresh and newer connection-flow work?
rationale: The branch still has useful, proven preview-mode work, but current main has overlapping onboarding fixes and the PR is conflict-heavy, so automation cannot choose the permanent product shape safely.

options.title: Adopt after rebase
options.body: Keep the PR open and require a rebase that preserves current-main saved-gateway and security setup behavior while carrying forward only the unique preview experience.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Close or supersede this branch and ask for a smaller PR focused on preview/sample-data pieces not already covered by current main.

recommendation.title: Adopt after rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require a rebase that preserves current-main saved-gateway and security setup behavior while carrying forward only the unique preview experience.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main saved-gateway routing fix and are the best identified owner for deciding whether this feature can rebase over that behavior.
